articles.headline: World Cup 2026 - updates, news as Ghana hold England, Bafana brace for South Korea
articles.description: Ghana held England to a 0-0 draw on Tuesday, but Congo DR lost 1-0 to Colombia. South Africa will likely need a win on Wednesday against South Korea to advance.

articles.headline: Lineker, Shearer, Owen, Rooney, Kane - is England's near half-century of world-class strikers about to end?
articles.description: With an elite striker having worn the Three Lions on their chest for 42 years, England have taken the position for granted - but is Harry Kane the last?

articles.headline: World Cup 2026: Which players from your Premier League team are there?
articles.description: Which Premier League players from your team are representing their country at the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico?

articles.headline: A draw will be enough, but South Korea must go for the win against South Africa
articles.description: A draw against South Africa will be enough for South Korea to progress at the World Cup -- but they should be going all out for the win.

articles.headline: Is the rest of Africa really 'hate-watching' Bafana at the FIFA World Cup?
articles.description: African fans have mixed feelings about backing South Africa at the FIFA World Cup amidst xenophobia concerns.

articles.headline: Scotland's 2026 World Cup squad: All 26 players picked by Steve Clarke and why
articles.description: Scotland manager Steve Clarke has named the 26 players he believes can make an impression at the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
